findings.title: Container connects to a port the Service does not expose
findings.cause: container client exits because its connection to Service web on port 8080 times out: the Service does not expose 8080, it listens on 80 and forwards to the pods' port 8080; its log says: "wget: download timed out"; Deployment client has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container client exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container client's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to web:8080 (10.96.182.161:8080)
wget: download timed out

evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-service-port-not-exposed -o jsonpath='{range .spec.ports[*]}{.port}{" -> "}{.targetPort}{"\n"}{end}'

findings.fix: Connect to web:80: 8080 is the pods' port (the Service's targetPort), and a client of a Service uses the Service's own port. Or change the Service's port to 8080.
